sources.title: GitHub - silveroxides/ComfyUI-UtilsCollection
sources.snippet: ComfyUI-UtilsCollection A collection of ComfyUI nodes for modern text and multimodal conditioning, image and mask processing, prompt presets, workflow parameters, loading, and general utilities. The encoder nodes track current ComfyUI Core behavior while retaining compatible legacy node IDs where practical.
